input.summary: Cap HDI's records inspection right at once per year in §3.4.
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 3.4 gives HDI an unlimited number of inspections of our records; our playbook fallback requires audits to be limited to once per year. We have added that frequency cap and left the existing 30 days' notice, business-hours and HDI-borne cost terms untouched.

ops.oldText: may upon no less than thirty (30) days prior written notice to the Company, have the right to inspect
ops.newText: may, no more than once per year and upon no less than thirty (30) days prior written notice to the Company, have the right to inspect
